test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In ΔCAB, ∠CAB = 90° and AD ⊥ BC. If AC = 24 cm, AB = 10 cm, then find the value of AD (in cm).
solution:
**Given:**

∠CAB = 90° 

AD ⊥ BC.

AC = 24 cm, AB = 10 cm

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2db55433a3d26efa999a2386d2e9156cb7c8bd7e619983ea73126b5c46dc61e2.png] 

BC² = AC² + AB²

⇒BC² = (24)² + (10)²

⇒BC = sqrt{(576+100)} = sqrt{676}

⇒BC = 26 cm

Now,

Area of Δ ABC = 1/2 × AC × AB

⇒ 1/2 × BC × AD = 1/2 × 24 × 10

⇒ 26 × AD = 24 × 10

⇒ AD = 240/26 = 120/13

⇒ AD = 9.23 cm

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
